description: Fixture session JSONLs for the TypeScript claude-jsonl.ts parser. Each <sid>.jsonl ships with <sid>.expected.json containing the output of Python's parse_session_turns + aggregate_turns. The TS port must diff-clean against these.
validation_policy: TS parse output must match Python's `turns` array bit-exact (same length, same per-turn UsageDict). Insertion order must match — the dedup-by-highest-output rule must NOT change the first-seen position of an id.

fixtures.label: small-vanilla
fixtures.why_picked: Clean small session, 4 assistant messages with 1 duplicate-id pair. Validates the basic dedup path.

fixtures.label: small-edgee
fixtures.why_picked: Edgee-side small session — exercises any backend-specific JSONL shape differences (none expected, but worth checking).

fixtures.label: large-with-many-dups
fixtures.why_picked: Large session: 55 assistant msgs but only 36 unique ids — 19 duplicates that exercise the keep-highest-output-tokens rule. Primary stress test for the dedup logic.
